title: The finite formal comparison graph surjects onto the first ideal quotient
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], J a quasi-coherent ideal, and F,Fprime,H coherent modules with a:F→H and aprime:Fprime→H. Completion and formal quotients are [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For a formal map theta:Fhat→Fprimehat satisfying theta followed by aprimehat = ahat and n≥0, put P=F×_H Fprime and d=p2 followed by qprime minus p1 followed by q followed by theta_n, where q,qprime are the J^(n+1) quotient projections. Then ker(d)→P→F→F/JF is epi. No power-torsion hypothesis on aprime is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0889(1), affine comparison; Tag 087W; Algebra Tag 00MB

proof.text: Coherent kernel and binary-sum closure identifies the ordinary pullback as a coherent module using Mathlib Abelian.PullbackToBiproductIsKernel.isLimitPullbackToBiproduct. Exactness of coherent completion gives preservation of finite limits via Functor.exact_tfae. Map the ordinary coherent pullback cone through completion and lift (id, theta), using htheta, to a formal map g with first projection id and second projection theta.

Apply formalGraph_discrepancy_zero to p, q and the formal lift g. Its projection identities give exactly the two hypotheses, so the completed discrepancy vanishes. This lemma proves the componentwise quotient calculation and its propagation through stabilized target transitions.

Ordinary coherent kernel closure gives K=ker(d). Its kernel fork is limiting in the full coherent subcategory, by the ordinary kernel universal property. Completion preserves this fork, so g lifts to v into the completion of K. The composite v followed by the completed kernel inclusion and first projection is id. Evaluate at index zero: the induced quotient map K/JK to F/JF has a right inverse, hence is epi. Precompose with the epimorphic quotient projection K to K/JK; the defining quotient-map equation identifies the resulting composite with the required kernel inclusion followed by first projection followed by F to F/JF.

lean.statement:
theorem formalGraph_first_quotient_epi
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    {H F F' : CoherentModules X} (a : F ⟶ H) (a' : F' ⟶ H)
    (θ : (completion X J).obj F ⟶ (completion X J).obj F')
    (hθ : θ ≫ (completion X J).map a' = (completion X J).map a)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let t : formalModuleQuotient J (n + 1) F.obj ⟶
        formalModuleQuotient J (n + 1) F'.obj := θ.hom.app (op n)
    let d : pullback a.hom a'.hom ⟶ formalModuleQuotient J (n + 1) F'.obj :=
      pullback.snd a.hom a'.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F'.obj -
        pullback.fst a.hom a'.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F.obj ≫ t
    Epi (kernel.ι d ≫ pullback.fst a.hom a'.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ J 1 F.obj)
